$comment: Canonical PROPOSED geometry contract for the fictional vessel Aurora Tide (WP-02). Derived from the approved appearance reference public/cinematic/aurora-tide.webp (A-02). Values marked proposed require owner approval before final modeling. Not a real ship, not an engineering or classification document.
status: provisionally-approved-direction; subject to Codex independent review and final appearance approval
units: metres. x = 0 at the stern (top of the raked transom) increasing to the bow; y = 0 on the centreline, positive = port; z = 0 at the baseline (keel). All z values, including the mast top, are above the baseline; heights above the waterline are stated as such.

principal.rationale: Generation brief for A-02 described ~160 m with five to six observation tiers; L/B 6.9 is typical of boutique/expedition proportions; 5.4 m draft keeps decks 1-2 below the waterline as in the concept, where only portholes appear near the water.

airDraft.definition: mast top z 37.5 m above baseline (superstructure.mast.topZ) minus design waterline z 5.4 m (principal.waterlineZ)
airDraft.note: Earlier field airDraftToMastTop = 37.5 was a baseline height mislabelled as air draft; geometry unchanged.

windowRows.type: small square portholes, sparse (crew / marina level)

shellDoors.purpose: gangway shell door (assumed, starboard mirror unseen)

hull.sheerNote: Top of the hull shell (bulwark top around terrace T1 aft of x = 9). Linear between points.
hull.modelledBelowDWLNote: The massing hull stops visibleBelowWaterline below the DWL; the underwater body is intentionally omitted.
hull.bowTaperRule: Waterplane half-breadths in the bow taper are compressed so each waterline ends on the raked stem: at height z the hull ends at x = bowRakeWaterlineX + (z − DWL)/(bowSheerTopZ − DWL) × (bowRakeTopX − bowRakeWaterlineX).
hull.sternRakeRule: The transom rakes from x = sternRakeWaterlineX at the DWL to x = sternRakeTopX at the deck 4 / terrace T1 level.

slotRule.note: modules run from level aft wall + aftClearance to level fore end − foreClearance, skipping cores

accommodation.fitRule: A slot is valid only if, over its complete footprint (sampled every 0.05 m), corridorHalfWidth + corridorBulkhead + interiorDepth + balconyDepth (balcony decks; cabinVariants override it for the listed cabins only) + sideStructureAllowance ≤ the local side line of its level (decks 5–7: superstructure side; deck 4: hull side − hullLining).

slotRanges.note: slot range per deck: deck 4 = terrace T1 wall + 11 m to 132 m; deck 5 = forward of the lifeboat bay (glazing band 64–122 + 2 m); decks 6–7 = level extent

cabinVariants.reason: standard 2.1 m balcony is 0.23 m short in the forward taper over the full footprint (Codex review finding 6)

cabinVariants.verification: Approved at 1.87 m subject to final geometric verification. Full-footprint check: available 9.2898 m from the corridor edge at x 116 allows at most 1.8698 m; 1.87 m overshoots by 0.2 mm, so the verified value is rounded down to 1.86 m (7.92 m² clear, 0.01 m margin).

D-W02-1.text: Option A: Cabin 9214 renamed Cabin 7214, premium Balcony Stateroom, Deck 7 port. No owner's-suite conversion, no deck re-basing. Preserve the approved luxury interior/spatial experience.

D-W02-2.text: 158 m x 23 m x 5.4 m, nine decks, four stepped aft terraces, three principal panoramic glazing bands, pearl-white superstructure, deep navy hull, restrained sea-glass detailing. Fictional design-control values, not certified maritime engineering.

D-W02-3.text: Replace the 1,900-guest / 14-deck values with ~208 guests, 104 staterooms, nine decks; derived capacity is the current design basis. Reconcile every future Ships & Rooms display; no unrelated system changes.

D-W02-4.text: Mirrored starboard, stepped stern and marina platform, Deck 8 forward bridge, proposed funnel, Deck 9 open sun deck, Deck 7 aft recreation/terrace. Present complete sheets and the concept overlay before freezing.

D-W02-5.text: Zero unapproved spending. No paid freelancer, GPU rental, render subscription or asset purchase. Do not commission production rendering until: Codex review, defects corrected, design approved, film-framing/golden-hour conflict resolved, viable zero-cost resource arranged. The GLB is massing only.

D-W02-6.text: Accommodation offering: Offer Oceanview Stateroom and Premium Balcony Stateroom, with Signature Cabin 7214 (Deck 7). Interior Staterooms removed (not supported by the canonical layout). Tidekeeper Suite kept as a future design concept only, never shown as available until its geometry, deck placement and capacity impact are validated and approved. The derived 104 staterooms / ~208 guests basis is preserved.

D-W02-7.status: approved; lounge location proposed on sheet 09 (pending owner acceptance)
D-W02-7.text: Amenities: Remove the large conventional theatre and the kids' splash zone. Replace the theatre with an intimate boutique entertainment lounge (live music, evening performance, social gatherings), advertised only once located in the canonical deck plan. Retain pool and aft recreation terraces, sun deck, spa and fitness, panoramic observation lounge, premium dining, Nightwatch Patisserie, promenade and the shore-excursion concierge desk. No unsupported amenities.

D-W02-8.text: Cabin 7214 programme and figures: Spatial programme approved as the provisional interior foundation. 31.9 m² net interior and 9.0 m² balcony accepted as the provisional basis, subject to independent geometry/clearance verification. Minimum clearance is a fictional design target, not a certified accessibility or maritime-safety claim.

D-W02-9.text: Concept overlay and identity: ~90 % silhouette agreement accepted as design-control evidence; no further optimisation for the percentage. Overlay must be reproducible (deterministic seed, recorded camera). Specification identity and generated-model identity are distinct.

D-W02-10.text: Golden-hour composition: Move the featured-excursion card into the left-side safe area; vessel stays on the right. Implementation is WP-01's (Codex, PR #2). Camera, ship and environment identical across daylight and sunset.

D-W02-11.text: Forward tapered balconies: cabins 7305 and 7306 (deck 7, x 111.4–116) keep their slot and full 7.2 m interior; only their balconies are reduced from 2.1 m; approved at 1.87 m (≈7.97 m²) subject to final geometric verification, which allows at most 1.8698 m, so the recorded value is 1.86 m (7.92 m² clear). Applies to these two cabins only. Capacity stays 104 staterooms / ~208 guests; vessel dimensions, exterior geometry and Signature Cabin 7214 (9.0 m² balcony) unchanged.

convention.frame: u along the ship from the aft dividing-bulkhead centreline (u = 0) to the forward one (u = moduleWidth); w outboard from the inner face of the corridor bulkhead (w = 0).
convention.corridorBulkhead: occupies w −0.12…0, outside the interior depth; its outer face is the corridor edge at |y| = corridorHalfWidth
convention.dividingBulkheads: 0.10 m, centred on u = 0 and u = moduleWidth (interior u 0.05…4.55)
convention.glazingLine: sliding-door frame 0.10 m centred on w = interiorDepth (7.15…7.25)
convention.balcony: floor from w 7.25 to the balustrade inner face at w = interiorDepth + balconyDepth − 0.05; balustrade 0.05 m
convention.areas: gross module = moduleWidth × interiorDepth (to bulkhead centrelines and glazing line); net floor = interior floor polygon minus internal partition footprints (door openings counted as floor); balcony = clear floor between privacy screens

layout.note: Corrected after Codex review P1 (entry obstructed by the wardrobe). Rectangles in the cabin frame: [u0, u1, w0, w1]. tall = full height (blocks sight lines).
